queries.name: Accounts with weak password storage encryption
queries.description: Accounts whose password was set before the existence of Windows Server 2008 Domain Controllers, either explicitly or at account creation, and which therefore lack the AES encryption keys required for Kerberos authentication after RC4 disablement enforcement. The Windows Server 2008 release date is the earliest date AES keys can exist in any domain, so accounts in domains that promoted their first AES-capable Domain Controller later are not returned. The creation date of the Read-only Domain Controllers group provides the exact per-domain threshold.

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:Base)
// Password was set before AES keys could be generated
WHERE (
  n.pwdlastset < 1204070400 // Windows Server 2008 release date
  AND NOT n.pwdlastset IN [-1.0, 0.0]
)
// Password was never reset since creation, and creation predates AES support
OR (
  n.pwdlastset IN [-1.0, 0.0]
  AND n.whencreated < 1204070400 // Windows Server 2008 release date
  AND NOT n.whencreated IN [-1.0, 0.0]
)
RETURN n
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Computers with non-default Primary Group membership

queryList.query:

AND (

    AND coalesce(n.isreadonlydc, false) = false
    AND NOT g.objectid ENDS WITH "-516" // Domain Controllers
  )

  (
    coalesce(n.isdc, false) = false

    AND NOT g.objectid ENDS WITH "-515" // Domain Computers
  )
)
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Computers with passwords older than the default maximum password age
queries.description: Machine account passwords are regularly changed for security purposes. Starting with Windows 2000-based computers, the machine account password automatically changes every 30 days.

queryList.query:
WITH 60 as rotation_period
MATCH (n:Computer)
WHERE n.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (rotation_period * 86400)) // password not rotated
AND n.enabled = true // enabled computers
AND n.whencreated < (datetime().epochseconds - (rotation_period * 86400)) // exclude recently created computers
AND n.lastlogontimestamp > (datetime().epochseconds - (rotation_period * 86400)) // active computers (Replicated value)
AND n.lastlogon > (datetime().epochseconds - (rotation_period * 86400)) // active computers (Non-replicated value)
RETURN n

queryList.query:

MATCH (n:Computer)
WHERE n.enabled = true
AND n.whencreated < (datetime().epochseconds - (password_age_days * 86400))
AND n.lastlogontimestamp > (datetime().epochseconds - (60 * 86400))
AND n.lastlogon > (datetime().epochseconds - (60 * 86400))
AND n.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (password_age_days * 86400))
AND ANY(spn IN n.serviceprincipalnames WHERE
  toLower(spn) CONTAINS 'mssqlservercluster' OR
  toLower(spn) CONTAINS 'mssqlserverclustermgmtapi' OR
  toLower(spn) CONTAINS 'msclustervirtualserver')

LIMIT 1000

Assumes default KDC settings and available AES keys; does not inspect effective KDC policy or key material.

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:Base)
WHERE n.hasspn = true
AND ANY(encryption_type IN n.supportedencryptiontypes
  WHERE encryption_type <> 'Not defined')
AND NONE(encryption_type IN n.supportedencryptiontypes WHERE encryption_type IN [
  'AES128-CTS-HMAC-SHA1-96',
  'AES256-CTS-HMAC-SHA1-96'
])
RETURN n
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: KRBTGT accounts with passwords not rotated in over 1 year

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:User)
WHERE (n.objectid ENDS WITH '-502'
OR n.name STARTS WITH 'AZUREADKERBEROS.'
OR n.name STARTS WITH 'KRBTGT_AZUREAD@')
AND n.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (365 * 86400))
RETURN n

queries.name: Managed Service Accounts with passwords older than the default maximum password age
queries.description: Managed Service Account (gMSA / sMSA) passwords are automatically changed by AD every 30 days for security purposes.

queryList.query:
WITH 60 as rotation_period
MATCH (n:Base)
WHERE (n.gmsa = true OR n.msa = true)
AND n.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (rotation_period * 86400)) // password not rotated
AND n.enabled = true // enabled principals
AND n.whencreated < (datetime().epochseconds - (rotation_period * 86400)) // exclude recently created computers
AND n.lastlogontimestamp > (datetime().epochseconds - (rotation_period * 86400)) // active computers (Replicated value)
AND n.lastlogon > (datetime().epochseconds - (rotation_period * 86400)) // active computers (Non-replicated value)
RETURN n

queries.name: Microsoft Entra Connect accounts with passwords not rotated in over 90 days
queries.description: Micosoft recommends to change the password of MSOL accounts every 90 days to prevent attackers from allowing use of the high privileges

queryList.query:
WITH 90 as days_since_change
MATCH (u:User)
WHERE u.name STARTS WITH "MSOL_"
AND u.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (days_since_change * 86400))
AND NOT u.pwdlastset IN [-1.0, 0.0]
RETURN u

queries.name: Nested groups within Tier Zero / High Value

queryList.query:
MATCH p=(t:Group)<-[:MemberOf*..]-(s:Group)
WHERE (t:Tag_Tier_Zero)
AND NOT s.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' // Domain Admins
AND NOT s.objectid ENDS WITH '-519' // Enterprise Admins
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: No break-glass test using built-in domain Administrator account in the last year
queries.description: Identifies enabled built-in domain Administrator accounts (RID 500) with no logon activity in the past year, indicating break-glass testing is not being performed. Regular break-glass tests are critical to ensuring disaster recovery procedures are operational.

queryList.query:
WITH 365 as maximum_days
MATCH (n:User)
WHERE n.objectid ENDS WITH "-500" // Built-in domain Administrator (RID 500)
AND n.enabled = true
AND n.whencreated < (datetime().epochseconds - (maximum_days * 86400)) // Account created more than 365 days ago
AND (
  n.lastlogontimestamp < (datetime().epochseconds - (maximum_days * 86400))
  AND n.lastlogon < (datetime().epochseconds - (maximum_days * 86400))
)
RETURN n
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Non-default delegation on MicrosoftDNS container

queryList.query:
MATCH p=(n:Base)-[r]->(m:Container)
WHERE m.distinguishedname STARTS WITH "CN=MICROSOFTDNS,CN=SYSTEM,DC="
AND NOT n.name STARTS WITH "DNSADMINS@"
AND NOT n.objectid =~ "-(512|544|519|9)$"
AND r.isacl
RETURN p

queries.name: Non-default members in Pre-Windows 2000 Compatible Access

queryList.query:
MATCH p=(n:Group)-[:MemberOf]->(m:Group)
WHERE NOT n.objectid ENDS WITH "S-1-5-11" // Authenticated Users
AND NOT (n.objectid ENDS WITH "S-1-5-7" // Anonymous
AND NOT n.objectid ENDS WITH "S-1-1-0") // Everyone
AND m.objectid ENDS WITH "S-1-5-32-554" // Pre-Windows 2000 Compatible Access
RETURN p

queries.name: Non-Tier Zero account with 'Admin Count' flag
queries.description: Accounts that were members of AD's built-in administrative groups, thus had the 'AdminCount' flag set, but are not currently in those groups and not tagged as Tier Zero. These accounts could still be highly privileged by other means.

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:Base)
WHERE (n:User OR n:Computer)
AND n.admincount = true
AND NOT (n:Tag_Tier_Zero)
AND NOT n.objectid ENDS WITH '-502' // KRBTGT user
AND NOT n.objectid ENDS WITH '-500' // Administrator user
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:MemberOf]->(g:Group)
WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' // Domain Admins
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-548' // Account Operators
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-544' // Administrators
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-551' // Backup Operators
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-516' // Domain Controllers
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-519' // Enterprise Admins
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-527' // Enterprise Key Admins
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-526' // Key Admins
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-550' // Print Operators
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-521' // Read-Only Domain Controllers
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-552' // Replicators
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-518' // Schema Admins
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-549' // Server Operators
WITH n, g
WHERE g IS NULL
RETURN n

queries.name: Non-Tier Zero principals with access to enabled gMSA passwords
queries.description: Finds non-Tier Zero principals that can read Group Managed Service Account (gMSA) passwords, or modify the msDS-GroupMSAMembership property controlling read access. Unauthorized access to gMSA passwords allows an attacker to authenticate as the service account and access any resource it manages.

queryList.query:
MATCH p1=(s1:Base)-[r:ReadGMSAPassword|GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteOwner|WriteDacl]->(d1:Base)
WHERE s1<>d1
AND d1.gmsa = true
AND d1.enabled = true
// Exclude Tier Zero principals
AND NOT (s1:Tag_Tier_Zero)
MATCH p2 = (s2:Base)-[:MemberOf*1..]->()-[:ReadGMSAPassword|GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteOwner|WriteDacl]->(d2:Base)
WHERE s2<>d2
AND d2.gmsa = true
AND d2.enabled = true
// Exclude Tier Zero principals
AND NOT (s2:Tag_Tier_Zero)
RETURN p1,p2

queries.name: Non-Tier Zero Principals with Control of Disabled Objects
queries.description: Identifies non-Tier Zero users, groups, or computers with dangerous control permissions over disabled user or computer objects.

queryList.query:
MATCH p = (source)-[r:GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteAccountRestrictions|WriteOwner|Owns|OwnsLimitedRights|WriteOwnerLimitedRights]->(target)
WHERE (source:User OR source:Group OR source:Computer)
AND NOT (source:Tag_Tier_Zero)
AND (target:User OR target:Computer)
AND target.enabled = false
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Non-Tier Zero principals with GPO link control over Tier Zero containers
queries.description: Non-Tier Zero principals that can link, or gain the ability to link, GPOs on Tier Zero containers such as the domain head or Domain Controllers OU. This grants indirect control over all objects within those containers.

queryList.query:
MATCH p = (n:Base)-[r:WriteGPLink|GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|Owns]->(t:Base)
WHERE (t:Domain OR t:OU)
AND (t:Tag_Tier_Zero)
AND NOT (n:Tag_Tier_Zero)
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Object name conflict
queries.description: When two objects are created with the same Relative Distinguished Name (RDN) in the same parent Organizational Unit or container, the conflict is recognized by the system when one of the new objects replicates to another domain controller. When this happens, one of the objects is renamed with 'CNF'

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:Base)
WHERE n.distinguishedname CONTAINS 'CNF:'
RETURN n

queries.name: Overprivileged Microsoft Entra Connect accounts
queries.description: Legacy MSOL accounts were by default deployed with Domain Admins or Enterprise Admins membership.

queryList.query:
MATCH p=(n:User)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group)
WHERE n.name STARTS WITH "MSOL_"
AND (g.objectid ENDS WITH "-512" // Domain Admins
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH "-519") // Entterprise Admins
RETURN p

queries.name: Principals with DES-only Kerberos authentication

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:Base)
WHERE n.enabled = true
AND n.usedeskeyonly = true
RETURN n

queries.name: Principals With Direct Rights Assignment
queries.description: Identifies principals with rights assigned directly to them instead of to groups they are a member of. Active Directory best practice requires granting rights to groups, then adding users as group members. This role-based access control (RBAC) approach ensures permissions are easily auditable and manageable. Results include inherited rights, which must be modified at the parent container level.

queryList.query:
MATCH p=(s:Base)-[r:AD_ATTACK_PATHS]->(t:Base)
WHERE (s:User OR s:Computer)
AND NOT type(r) IN ["MemberOf"]

// Uncomment the below to only search enabled principals.
// AND s.enabled = true

RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Principals with passwords stored using reversible encryption

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:Base)
WHERE n.encryptedtextpwdallowed = true
RETURN n

queries.name: Principals with weak supported Kerberos encryption types

queryList.query:
MATCH (u:Base)
WHERE 'DES-CBC-CRC' IN u.supportedencryptiontypes
OR 'DES-CBC-MD5' IN u.supportedencryptiontypes
OR 'RC4-HMAC-MD5' IN u.supportedencryptiontypes
RETURN u

queries.name: Return users with a variant of "password" in their password and a path to high value targets (limit to 25 results)

queryList.query: match (u1:User) WHERE u1.plaintextpassword =~ "(.*[pP][aA@][sS$][sS$][wW][oO0][rR][dD].*)"  MATCH p=shortestPath((u1:User)-[*1..]->(n {highvalue:true})) WHERE  u1<>n return u1 LIMIT 25

queries.name: Return users with a variant of "password" in their password and are high value targets

queryList.query: MATCH (u1:User) WHERE u1.plaintextpassword =~ "(.*[pP][aA@][sS$][sS$][wW][oO0][rR][dD].*)" MATCH p=(u1:User)-[r:MemberOf*1..]->(m:Group {highvalue:true}) RETURN u1

queries.name: Return users with a variant of "password" in their password and have local admin on at least one computer

queryList.query: match (u1:User) WHERE u1.plaintextpassword =~ "(.*[pP][aA@][sS$][sS$][wW][oO0][rR][dD].*)" match p=(u1:User)-[r:AdminTo]->(n:Computer) RETURN p

queries.name: Return users with seasons in their password and a path to high value targets (limit to 25 results)

queryList.query: match (u1:User) WHERE u1.plaintextpassword =~ "([Ww]inter.*|[sS]pring.*|[sS]ummer.*|[fF]all.*)" MATCH p=shortestPath((u1:User)-[*1..]->(n {highvalue:true})) WHERE  u1<>n return u1 LIMIT 25

queries.name: Return users with seasons in their password and are high value targets

queryList.query: MATCH (u1:User) WHERE u1.plaintextpassword =~ "([Ww]inter.*|[sS]pring.*|[sS]ummer.*|[fF]all.*)" MATCH p=(u1:User)-[r:MemberOf*1..]->(m:Group {highvalue:true}) RETURN u1

queries.name: Return users with seasons in their password and have local admin on at least one computer

queryList.query: match (u1:User) WHERE u1.plaintextpassword =~ "([Ww]inter.*|[sS]pring.*|[sS]ummer.*|[fF]all.*)" match p=(u1:User)-[r:AdminTo]->(n:Computer) RETURN p

queries.name: Smart card accounts with passwords not rotated in over 1 year

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:Base)
WHERE n.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (365 * 86400))
AND n.enabled = true
AND n.smartcardrequired = true
RETURN n

queries.name: Tier Zero / High Value enabled users not requiring smart card authentication

queryList.query:
MATCH (u:User)
WHERE (u:Tag_Tier_Zero)
AND u.enabled = true
AND u.smartcardrequired = false
AND NOT u.name STARTS WITH 'MSOL_' // Removes false positive, Entra sync
AND NOT u.name STARTS WITH 'PROVAGENTGMSA' // Removes false positive, Entra sync
AND NOT u.name STARTS WITH 'ADSYNCMSA_' // Removes false positive, Entra sync
RETURN u

queries.name: Tier Zero / High Value users with non-expiring passwords

queryList.query:
MATCH (u:User)
WHERE (u:Tag_Tier_Zero) AND u.enabled = true
AND u.pwdneverexpires = true
RETURN u
LIMIT 100

queries.name: Tier Zero accounts not members of Denied RODC Password Replication Group

queryList.query:
// Get all Tier Zero accounts that are members of Denied RODC Password Replication Group
MATCH (n:Base)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(m:Group)
WHERE (n:Tag_Tier_Zero)
AND (n:User OR n:Computer)
AND m.objectid ENDS WITH '-572' // Denied RODC Password Replication Group
WITH COLLECT(n.objectid) AS MembersOfDeniedGroup

// Get all Tier Zero accounts
MATCH (x:Base)
WHERE (x:Tag_Tier_Zero)
AND (x:User OR x:Computer)

// Filter the members of Denied RODC Password Replication Group
AND NOT x.objectid IN MembersOfDeniedGroup
RETURN x

queries.name: Tier Zero computers with passwords older than the default maximum password age

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:Computer)
WHERE n.enabled = true
AND n.whencreated < (datetime().epochseconds - (60 * 3 * 86400))
AND n.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (60 * 3 * 86400))
AND (n:Tag_Tier_Zero)
RETURN n

queries.name: Tier Zero computers with the WebClient running

queryList.query:
MATCH (c:Computer)
WHERE c.webclientrunning = True
AND (c:Tag_Tier_Zero)
RETURN c LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Tier Zero computers with unsupported operating systems

queryList.query:
MATCH (c:Computer)
WHERE c.operatingsystem =~ '(?i).*Windows.* (2000|2003|2008|2012|xp|vista|7|8|me|nt).*'
AND (c:Tag_Tier_Zero)
RETURN c
LIMIT 100

queries.name: Tier Zero OU containing Non-Tier Zero principals
queries.description: Identifies Tier Zero OUs that contain Non-Tier Zero principals. Organizations should logically structure their administrative tier structure with separate root OUs for each tier; mixing Tier Zero and Non-Tier Zero principals in the same OU is an exception and can be an indicator of inadequate tier isolation.

queryList.query:
MATCH p = (ou:OU)-[:Contains]->(n:Base)
WHERE (n:User OR n:Group OR n:Computer)
  AND (ou:Tag_Tier_Zero)
  AND NOT (n:Tag_Tier_Zero)
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Tier Zero principals without AdminSDHolder protection

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:Base)
WHERE (n:Tag_Tier_Zero)
AND n.adminsdholderprotected = false
RETURN n
LIMIT 500

queries.name: Tier Zero users not member of Protected Users

queryList.query:
MATCH (m:User)
WHERE (m:Tag_Tier_Zero)
OPTIONAL MATCH (g:Group)<-[:MemberOf*1..]-(n:Base)
WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH '-525'
WITH m, COLLECT(n) AS matchingNs
WHERE NONE(n IN matchingNs WHERE n.objectid = m.objectid)
RETURN m

queries.name: Tier Zero users with email
queries.description: Tier Zero accounts with email access have an increased attack surface.

queryList.query:
MATCH (n)
WHERE (n:Tag_Tier_Zero)
AND n.email <> ""
AND n.enabled = true
AND NOT toUpper(n.email) ENDS WITH ".ONMICROSOFT.COM"
AND NOT (
    (toUpper(n.email) STARTS WITH "HEALTHMAILBOX"
    OR toUpper(n.email) STARTS WITH "MSEXCHDISCOVERYMAILBOX"
    OR toUpper(n.email) STARTS WITH "MSEXCHDISCOVERY"
    OR toUpper(n.email) STARTS WITH "MSEXCHAPPROVAL"
    OR toUpper(n.email) STARTS WITH "FEDERATEDEMAIL"
    OR toUpper(n.email) STARTS WITH "SYSTEMMAILBOX"
    OR toUpper(n.email) STARTS WITH "MIGRATION.")
  AND
    (n.name STARTS WITH "SM_"
    OR n.name STARTS WITH "HEALTHMAILBOX")
)
RETURN n

queries.name: Tier Zero users with passwords not rotated in over 1 year

queryList.query:
WITH 365 as days_since_change
MATCH (u:User)
WHERE (u:Tag_Tier_Zero)
AND u.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (days_since_change * 86400))
AND NOT u.pwdlastset IN [-1.0, 0.0]
RETURN u
LIMIT 100

queries.name: Uncommon permission on containers
queries.description: BloodHound typically identifies risk on Active Directory objects stored in OUs, however behind the scenes; Active Directory has a hieracy of containers e.g. CN=SYSTEM and CN=CONFIGURATION, on which control can lead to risk. Results are prone to false-positives but can assist auditing containers permissions.

queries.name: Unresolved SID with outbound control

queryList.query:
MATCH p=(n:Base)-[r]->(:Base)
WHERE r.isacl
AND n.name CONTAINS "S-1-5-21-" // Unresolved SID
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Usage of built-in domain Administrator account
queries.description: Usage of Active Directory's built-in Administrator account is a sign that the account is not only used for break-glass purposes.

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:User)
WHERE n.objectid ENDS WITH "-500"
AND (
 n.lastlogontimestamp > (datetime().epochseconds - (60 * 86400)) OR
 n.lastlogon > (datetime().epochseconds - (60 * 86400))
)
AND NOT n.whencreated > (datetime().epochseconds - (60 * 86400))
RETURN n

queries.name: Users logged in the last 90 days

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.lastlogon < (datetime().epochseconds - (90 * 86400)) and NOT u.lastlogon IN [-1.0, 0.0] RETURN u

queries.name: Users never logged on and account still active

queryList.query: MATCH (n:User) WHERE n.lastlogontimestamp=-1.0 AND n.enabled=TRUE RETURN n

queries.name: Users which do not require password to authenticate

queryList.query:
MATCH (u:User)
WHERE u.passwordnotreqd = true
RETURN u
LIMIT 100

queries.name: Users with logon scripts

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:User)
WHERE n.logonscript IS NOT NULL
RETURN n

queries.name: Users with non-default Primary Group membership

queryList.query:
MATCH p=(n:User)-[r:MemberOf]->(g:Group)
WHERE r.isprimarygroup = true
AND (
  (
    n.objectid ENDS WITH "-501" // User: Guest
    AND NOT g.objectid ENDS WITH "-514" // Group: Domain Guests
  )
  OR
  (
    NOT n.objectid ENDS WITH "-501" // Other users
    AND NOT g.objectid ENDS WITH "-513" // Group: Domain Users
  )
)
AND (n.gmsa IS NULL OR n.gmsa = false)
AND (n.msa IS NULL OR n.msa = false)
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Users with non-expiring passwords

queryList.query:
MATCH (u:User)
WHERE u.enabled = true
AND u.pwdneverexpires = true
RETURN u
LIMIT 100

queries.name: Users with passwords last set in the last 90 days

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (90 * 86400)) and NOT u.pwdlastset IN [-1.0, 0.0] RETURN u

queries.name: Users with passwords not rotated in over 1 year

queryList.query:
WITH 365 as days_since_change
MATCH (u:User)
WHERE u.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (days_since_change * 86400))
AND NOT u.pwdlastset IN [-1.0, 0.0]
RETURN u
LIMIT 100

queries.name: Map AD site topology
queries.description: Shows sites and the site-server or site-subnet objects they contain.

queryList.query:
MATCH p = (:Site)-[:Contains]->(n:Base)
WHERE n:SiteServer OR n:SiteSubnet
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Map site controllers
queries.description: Shows sites, their controllers, and the site-server or site-subnet objects they contain.

queryList.query:
MATCH p = (:Base)-[:Owns|WriteOwner|WriteDacl|GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteGPLink]->(:Site)-[:Contains]->(n:Base)
WHERE n:SiteServer OR n:SiteSubnet
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Map site servers to computers
queries.description: Shows SiteServer nodes and the Computer objects they resolve to through ServerIs.

queryList.query:
MATCH p = (:Site)-[:Contains]->(:SiteServer)-[:ServerIs]->(:Computer)
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Map site-linked GPO controllers
queries.description: Shows site-linked GPO controllers and affected site-servers and site-subnets

queryList.query:
MATCH p = (:Base)-[:Owns|WriteOwner|WriteDacl|GenericAll|GenericWrite]->(:GPO)-[:GPLink]->(:Site)-[:Contains]->(n:Base)
WHERE n:SiteServer OR n:SiteSubnet
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Map site-linked GPOs
queries.description: Shows site-linked GPOs and affected site-servers and site-subnets

queryList.query:
MATCH p = (:GPO)-[:GPLink]->(:Site)-[:Contains]->(n:Base)
WHERE n:SiteServer OR n:SiteSubnet
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All privileged Azure Service Principals
queries.description: Return all privileged Azure Service Principals.

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:AZServicePrincipal)
OPTIONAL MATCH p1=(n)-[:AZHasRole]->(:AZRole)
OPTIONAL MATCH p2=(n)-[:AZMemberOf*1..]->(:AZGroup)-[:AZHasRole]->(:AZRole)
RETURN p1, p2

queries.name: Azure groups nested more than 3 levels
queries.description: Identifies Azure AD groups nested more than 3 levels deep. Excessive nesting complexity reduces auditability and increases the risk of misconfigured permissions.

queryList.query:
MATCH p = (:AZGroup)-[:AZMemberOf*3..]->(:AZGroup)
// Matches Azure groups with 3 or more MemberOf hops to another Azure group
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Azure tenants with fewer than 2 Global Administrators
queries.description: Global Administrator role with fewer than 2 assigned members, creating a single point of failure for Entra ID tenant administration and emergency access.

queryList.query:
MATCH (m:AZBase)-[:AZHasRole|AZRoleEligible]->(r:AZRole)
WHERE r.objectid STARTS WITH '62E90394-69F5-4237-9190-012177145E10' // Global Administrator role
WITH r, COUNT(m) AS gaCount
WHERE gaCount < 2 // fewer than 2 members assigned
RETURN r

queries.name: Azure tenants with more than 5 Global Administrators
queries.description: Global Administrator role with more than 5 assigned members, exceeding Microsoft's recommended maximum and unnecessarily expanding the blast radius of a tenant compromise.

queryList.query:
MATCH (m:AZBase)-[:AZHasRole|AZRoleEligible]->(r:AZRole)
WHERE r.objectid STARTS WITH '62E90394-69F5-4237-9190-012177145E10' // Global Administrator role
WITH r, COUNT(m) AS gaCount
WHERE gaCount > 5 // exceeds recommended maximum of 5
RETURN r

queries.name: Circular AZ group memberships
queries.description: Detects circular group membership chains where groups are members of themselves through one or more intermediate groups. This causes an administrative complexity.

queryList.query:
MATCH p=(x:AZGroup)-[:AZMemberOf*2..]->(y:AZGroup)
WHERE x.objectid=y.objectid
RETURN p
LIMIT 100

queries.name: Devices with unsupported operating systems
Disabled Tier Zero / High Value principals (AZ)

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:AZBase)
WHERE (n:Tag_Tier_Zero)
AND n.enabled = false
RETURN n
LIMIT 100

queries.name: Enabled Entra ID guest users inactive for 30 days
queries.description: Entra ID guest (external) user accounts with no sign-in activity in the past 30 days, or that have never signed in. Stale guest accounts retain tenant access despite being unused and are a persistence risk if compromised.

queries.name: Enabled Entra ID users inactive for 90 days
queries.description: Enabled Entra ID user accounts with no sign-in activity in 90 days, or that have never signed in. Stale accounts expand the attack surface and may go unmonitored.

queries.name: Enabled Entra Tier Zero principals inactive for 60 days
queries.description: Enabled Entra ID Tier Zero principals with no sign-in activity in 60 days, or that have never signed in. Stale privileged accounts should be reviewed and removed to reduce the attack surface.

queries.name: Find all paths to an Azure KeyVault

queryList.query: MATCH p = (n)-[r]->(g:AZKeyVault) RETURN p

queries.name: Find all paths to an Azure VM

queryList.query: MATCH p = (n)-[r]->(g:AZVM) RETURN p

queries.name: Find all Privileged Service Principals

queryList.query: MATCH p = (g:AZServicePrincipal)-[r]->(n) RETURN p

queries.name: Find the Shortest path to a high value target from an owned object

queryList.query: MATCH p=shortestPath((g {owned:true})-[*1..]->(n {highvalue:true})) WHERE  g<>n return p

queries.name: Find the Shortest path to a unconstrained delegation system from an owned object

queryList.query: MATCH (n) MATCH p=shortestPath((n)-[*1..]->(m:Computer {unconstraineddelegation: true})) WHERE NOT n=m AND n.owned = true RETURN p

queries.name: Foreign principals in Tier Zero / High Value targets

queryList.query:
MATCH (n:AZServicePrincipal)
WHERE (n:Tag_Tier_Zero)
AND NOT toUpper(n.appownerorganizationid) = toUpper(n.tenantid)
AND n.appownerorganizationid CONTAINS '-'
RETURN n
LIMIT 100

queries.name: Foreign Service Principals With Group Memberships
queries.description: Review each to validate whether their presence is expected and whether the assigned group memberships are appropriate for the foreign service principal.

queryList.query:
MATCH p = (sp:AZServicePrincipal)-[:AZMemberOf]->(g:AZGroup)
WHERE toUpper(sp.appownerorganizationid) <> toUpper(g.tenantid)
// Ensure AZServicePrincipal has a valid appownerorganizationid
AND sp.appownerorganizationid CONTAINS "-"
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Global Administrators with recent sign-in activity
queries.description: Entra ID principals assigned the Global Administrator role with sign-in activity in the past 14 days. Frequent use of the Global Administrator role indicates it is not being reserved for emergency access only.

queryList.query:
MATCH p=(m:AZBase)-[:AZHasRole|AZRoleEligible]->(n:AZRole)
WHERE n.objectid STARTS WITH '62E90394-69F5-4237-9190-012177145E10' // Global Administrator role
AND coalesce(m.lastsuccessfulsignindatetime, '') <> '' // sign-in data must be present
AND m.lastsuccessfulsignindatetime > date() - duration('P14D') // signed in within last 14 days
RETURN p

queries.name: Principals with deprecated or prohibited Entra role assignments
queries.description: Identifies principals assigned to Entra ID roles that are deprecated or should never be used, indicating stale or risky role assignments.

queryList.query:

queries.name: Collection health of CA Registry Data
queries.description: BloodHound's ADCS analysis requires collecting CA registry data to increase accuracy/enable more edges. Collection by default requires SharpHound has Administrators membership. Requires SharpHound v2.3.5 or above. It only requires one misconfigured CA to potentially a full forest compromise by any principal. EnterpriseCAs returned by this query have an incomplete collection for one or more of the queried attributes.

queryList.query:
MATCH p=(eca:EnterpriseCA)<-[:HostsCAService]-(c:Computer)
WHERE (
  NOT eca.casecuritycollected = true
  OR NOT eca.enrollmentagentrestrictionscollected = true
  OR NOT eca.isuserspecifiessanenabledcollected = true
  OR NOT eca.roleseparationenabledcollected = true
)
// Exclude inactive CAs
AND c.enabled = true
AND c.lastlogontimestamp > (datetime().epochseconds - (30 * 86400))
RETURN p

queries.name: Collection health of DC Registry Data
queries.description: Returns active DCs with incomplete collection of certificate binding enforcement or the Netlogon security descriptor. DC registry data supports BloodHound's ADCS analysis and assessment of Netlogon secure channel exceptions. Collection requires Administrators membership on the DC by default. Requires SharpHound v2.3.5 or above for certificate binding enforcement; Netlogon collection requires SharpHound v2.8.0 or above and BloodHound v8.3.0 or above.

queryList.query:
MATCH p=(:Domain)<-[:DCFor]-(c:Computer)
WHERE (
  c.strongcertificatebindingenforcementraw IS NULL
  OR c.vulnerablenetlogonsecuritydescriptorcollected IS NULL
  OR c.vulnerablenetlogonsecuritydescriptorcollected = false
)
// Exclude inactive DCs
AND c.enabled = true
AND c.lastlogontimestamp > (datetime().epochseconds - (30 * 86400))
RETURN p

queryList.query:
MATCH p=(c:Computer)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group)
WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH 'S-1-5-32-544' // Administrators
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH 'S-1-5-32-551' // Backup Operators
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' // Domain Admins
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-519' // Enterprise Admins
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-527' // Enterprise Key Admins
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-526' // Key Admins
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-518' // Schema Admins
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH 'S-1-5-32-548' // Account Operators
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH 'S-1-5-32-569' // Cryptographic Operators
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH 'S-1-5-32-562' // Distributed COM Users
OR g.name STARTS WITH 'DNSADMINS@' // DNS Admins
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH '-557' // Incoming Forest Trust Builders
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH 'S-1-5-32-559' // Performance Log Users
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH 'S-1-5-32-550' // Print Operators
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH 'S-1-5-32-549' // Server Operators
OR g.objectid ENDS WITH 'S-1-5-32-552' // Replicators
OR (g.objectid ENDS WITH '-516' AND NOT c.isdc = true) // Domain Controllers (excludes legitimate DCs)

WHERE child.collected = 'true'

RETURN p,t,boundary

queries.name: Kerberoastable users with most admin privileges

queryList.query:
MATCH (u:User)
WHERE u.hasspn = true
  AND u.enabled = true
  AND NOT u.objectid ENDS WITH '-502'
  AND NOT COALESCE(u.gmsa, false) = true
  AND NOT COALESCE(u.msa, false) = true
